registryDigestInputs.title: Note: add reference
registryDigestInputs.description: Makes the row point at another row, of any table it may point at, with a role (none unless given), once per target and role; answers the reference, the one there when it was there.

registryDigestInputs.title: Note: attachments
registryDigestInputs.description: Lists the row's ready files, oldest first.

registryDigestInputs.title: Note: backlinks
registryDigestInputs.description: Lists the rows that point at the row, across every table, through a reference or a ref block of a message, each one the caller can read, most recent first. Only the owner of a row whose audience is not everyone hears how many rows it cannot see point at it.

registryDigestInputs.title: Note: begin upload
registryDigestInputs.description: Starts an upload of a file to the row: a pending file, held to the table's bounds with the row's other files and uploads, and the URL the browser puts the file's bytes to, straight to the bucket, before it expires.
registryDigestInputs.hiddenReason: A file's upload, download and filing stay routes: its bytes go to and from the bucket through a signed URL, which no tool call carries (#723).

registryDigestInputs.title: Note: complete upload
registryDigestInputs.description: Checks an upload's bytes in the bucket against the size and SHA-256 its begin declared, and makes the file ready; a file whose bytes differ is removed.
registryDigestInputs.hiddenReason: A file's upload, download and filing stay routes: its bytes go to and from the bucket through a signed URL, which no tool call carries (#723).

registryDigestInputs.title: Note: download
registryDigestInputs.description: Signs a URL that downloads one of the row's files until it expires, and answers the file, whose preview this first view asks.
registryDigestInputs.hiddenReason: A file's upload, download and filing stay routes: its bytes go to and from the bucket through a signed URL, which no tool call carries (#723).

registryDigestInputs.title: Note: file attachment
registryDigestInputs.description: Files one of the row's files onto another row, which may be of another table, with no second upload: a copy that names the same object, or with move the file itself. When the table keeps references that may point at the other row, the row then points at it with the role (filed unless given), so the other row lists it among its backlinks.
registryDigestInputs.hiddenReason: A file's upload, download and filing stay routes: its bytes go to and from the bucket through a signed URL, which no tool call carries (#723).

registryDigestInputs.title: Note: references
registryDigestInputs.description: Lists the references the row holds, oldest first, each to a row the caller can read.

registryDigestInputs.title: Note: remove reference
registryDigestInputs.description: Stops the row pointing at another row with the role, or with any role when none is given; answers how many references it removed.
registryDigestInputs.hiddenReason: A reference's removal stays a route: a tool adds references and reads them (#723).
